title: D2P Tolerance Profile
description: Versioned vocabulary of numeric tolerances used to compare implementation results with expected fixture results (design decisions ADR-017.1, ADR-025). Agreement across implementations is judged with tolerance profiles, never with digests. A profile is pinned before any benchmark run and never adjusted afterwards to fit an implementation. Once status is frozen the profile is immutable: any changed limit is a new version. A profile with status provisional holds proposed values only and is not an adopted norm. Profile files are stored as tolerance-profiles/<local>-<version>.json for profileId d2p:<local>. Producers MUST sort tolerances by metric (UTF-16 code-unit order).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

profileId.description: Qualified name of the profile. Together with version it identifies the profile.

version.description: Version of the profile, independent of the standard version.

status.description: provisional: proposed values, not yet adopted, and not to be used for comparing implementations; frozen: adopted and immutable.

scope.description: What the profile applies to (for example a fixture and the kind of results compared).

tolerances.description: Tolerance entries, sorted by metric. Metrics without an agreed value are omitted.

notes.description: Free-text notes, for example on the provenance and status of the values.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest). Pins of this profile digest the whole file instead.

toleranceEntry.title: Tolerance entry
toleranceEntry.description: Limit for one metric. A measured deviation d passes if d <= limit, where d is the absolute deviation (absolute-lte) or |actual - expected| / expected (relative-lte).

unit.description: Unit of limit. For relative-lte comparisons this is 1.

comparison.description: How the deviation is computed and compared with limit.

toleranceComparison.title: Tolerance comparison
toleranceComparison.description: absolute-lte: |actual - expected| <= limit; relative-lte: |actual - expected| / expected <= limit.

toleranceMetric.title: Tolerance metric
toleranceMetric.description: Metric the limit applies to. Standard metrics: d2p:contour-deviation (mm, absolute-lte; Hausdorff distance between expected and actual contour, control points compare under this metric as degenerate contours), d2p:seam-length-deviation-relative (1, relative-lte), d2p:seam-length-deviation-absolute (mm, absolute-lte; for short seams), d2p:control-square-deviation (mm, absolute-lte; control-square side in file coordinates vs 100 mm), d2p:angle-deviation (rad, absolute-lte), d2p:mesh-planar-deviation (mm, absolute-lte; largest planar distance between a panel mesh boundary and the pinned pattern contour, catalog §3.9). Extension metrics use extension names.
